exercises.instructions: Choose the correct alternative to complete each sentence.

questions.question: There ________ three strangers outside the office.
questions.explanation: 'Were' is used with plural nouns. 'Three strangers' is plural. 'There was' is for singular nouns. 'There is' is present tense. 'There were' ကို အရာဝတ္ထု အများကြီးနဲ့ အတိတ်ကာလမှာ သုံးပါ။

questions.question: ________ there a stranger outside the house?
questions.explanation: 'Was there' is used with singular nouns. 'A stranger' is singular. 'Were there' is for plural nouns. 'Is there' is present tense. 'Was there' ကို အရာဝတ္ထုတစ်ခုတည်းနဲ့ အတိတ်ကာလ မေးခွန်းတွေမှာ သုံးပါ။

questions.question: There ________ money in the safe.
questions.explanation: 'There was' is used with uncountable nouns. 'Money' is uncountable. 'There were' is for plural nouns. 'There has' is grammatically incorrect here. 'There was' ကို တစ်ခါသုံး ဝေါဟာရတွေနဲ့ အတိတ်ကာလမှာ သုံးပါ။
